profile.summary: Lincoln, also known as Lincoln Families, is a nonprofit founded in 1883 that provides mental health and wellness services for children, youth and families in Alameda and Contra Costa counties. It runs school-based programs, such as behavioral and mental health supports and summer literacy programming, as well as community-based programs.

These fit OUSD's student-support and summer-program contracts. No source names OUSD explicitly, so identity rests on name, location and service fit, but the summary and contact fields are all supported and neutral.
